method.description: Current AI on both sides. Only different strategies face each other. Rotate strategy pairs modulo 3 and ordered opening pairs modulo 25, then replay each seed exchanging both strategy and opening sides. All 75 strategy-pair/opening-pair strata receive floor(pairs/75) or ceil(pairs/75) scenarios. Each opening has equal total exposure. The standardized win rate gives equal weight to each opponent strategy and each own/opponent opening combination. No career progression.
method.koWinDefinition: Victory by possession with all five opponents KO at the end. No automatic KO victory exists.

sourceCommitVerification: Every recorded source SHA-256 was verified against this commit after the run; measured source files were not changed. The after run initially used uncommitted files based on sourceBaseCommit.
